summary: All application data is stored in Supabase. Firestore is intentionally disabled and the rules block every collection to avoid legacy data leaks and auth/session mismatches.
notes: Firebase is only used for Google Workspace login flows in the admin panel.
No customer orders, wishlists, reviews, communication logs, or product data are stored in Firestore.
The authoritative schema lives in Supabase tables and the Edge Function app API.

firestore.description: Every Firestore collection is denied by rule: allow read, write: if false; see firestore.rules.
